author: Inside Edition
description: Adales Flores was walking her little dog in Chicago when she spotted two coyotes in a popular city park. She scooped up her chihuahua, Coco, into her arms and made a run for it. Coyote populations have been on the rise in major cities like San Francisco and Los Angeles, but nowhere in the United States has seen numbers of coyotes that Chicago is experiencing. It is estimated that 4,000 coyotes live in Chicago.
title: Woman Walking Her Chihuahua Spots 2 Coyotes In Chicago Park

author: Inside Edition
description: It's the big debate: do you decorate for Christmas now, or wait until after Thanksgiving? A recent poll found nearly 20% of adults put up holiday decorations before Thanksgiving. Kristi and David, who live in Manhattan's Upper East Side, say "Deck the halls now." Inside Edition was there as a professional team installed Christmas decorations at Joe and Valerie Lauto's house on Long Island. Steven Fabian spoke with Frank Grogan, the CEO of Blinky's Christmas Lights.
title: Is It Too Soon To Put Up Christmas Decorations?

author: Inside Edition
description: There's fallout today from a Veterans Day incident at Arlington National Cemetery. A group of visitors including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, his wife and advisors was scolded by a guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The guard is part of an elite cadre known as Army Sentinels. Hegseth commended the guard on social media today, writing, "Well done, Specialist." Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports.
title: Pete Hegseth Commends Army Sentinel Who Scolded Him At Tomb

author: Inside Edition
description: Basketball superstar Steph Curry is defending his wife after some fellow NBA players criticized her acting choices. It all stems from a scene of Ayesha Curry kissing another man on screen in her acting debut in the new movie "Second Chance Holiday." Nick Young and Gilbert Arenas commented on the scene in a recent episode of the "We Said What We Said" podcast; their remarks caused Curry to bristle.
title: Steph Curry Defends Wife Ayesha's Kissing Scene

author: Inside Edition
description: The nation watched breathlessly during the desperate rescue of a pregnant woman in the rubble of the deadly building collapse Wednesday. The woman, who is six months pregnant, was carried out on a backboard, and was then hauled up a ladder to an ambulance. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdan was at the scene Thursday. At least eight people are dead and 17 others are injured after the collapse. Inside Edition's Justin Finch is on the scene.
title: 'Miracle' Rescue Caught On Live TV

author: Inside Edition
description: Now that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of the AI technology company NVIDIA, Colette Kress will serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Before this, Colette Kress was the company's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. She joined NVIDIA in 2013, bringing nearly 25 years of financial leadership experience from leading technology companies. She also held senior finance positions at Cisco, Microsoft, and Texas Instruments. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Who Is NVIDIA’s New Interim CEO, Colette Kress?

title: Justin Finch Reports From Scene Of Brooklyn Building Collapse #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A mass shooting, not far from the White House, has left one person dead and four others injured. Officials in Washington, D.C. say a man opened fire inside a gym in Logan Circle. Police say he then fled to an apartment above the gym, where he barricaded himself inside what is believed to be his apartment. Police say they tried to negotiate with him for an hour to turn himself in. That’s when they heard a gunshot and forced entry into the unit. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Gunman Kills 1, Shoots 4 Others Near White House

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a miracle in the midst of devastation when a pregnant woman was found alive in the rubble of a deadly building collapse in Brooklyn. Officials say at least eight people are dead and 17 injured after the three-story building collapsed on Wednesday. The cause of the collapse is under investigation, but neighborhood residents say the incident is one they won’t be able to get over anytime soon. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Pregnant Woman Pulled Alive From Deadly Brooklyn Building Collapse
